sthr-hour-1.name: Hour I — First Dark
sthr-hour-1.back_flavor: Lanterns bob across the Square. Somewhere a band is tuning up for midnight. Above it all, one by one, the stars begin to go out.
sthr-hour-1.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-2.name: Hour II — Low Water
sthr-hour-2.text: When reached: each investigator draws 1 encounter card.
sthr-hour-2.back_flavor: The tide draws back from the Long Pier, farther than any tide should, and does not come in again. The harbour smells of something left too long in the dark.
sthr-hour-2.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-3.name: Hour III — The Thirteenth Toll
sthr-hour-3.text: When reached: raise Dissonance by 1. If any investigator is at a Church location, raise it by 2 instead. If the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll," skip the extra +1.
sthr-hour-3.back_flavor: The church bell counts the hour. Twelve. A pause, long enough to hope. Thirteen.
sthr-hour-3.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-4.name: Hour IV — The Road Gives Way
sthr-hour-4.text: When reached: the location with the fewest clues becomes impassable until the next Hour; investigators there move to a connecting location (that move is a Skip). If the log shows "The Hour Was Wrong," remove this Hour from the Occultation entirely.
sthr-hour-4.back_flavor: Out past the Milestones the road simply stops being there. The walkers on it do not break stride.
sthr-hour-4.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-5.name: Hour V — The Streets Empty
sthr-hour-5.text: When reached: each Sleepwalking Echo awakens if Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher. The Appointed's Approach advances to at least Sensed.
sthr-hour-5.back_flavor: The fair's music plays on for no one. Doors stand open along every street. The town has gone somewhere without moving.
sthr-hour-5.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-6.name: Hour VI — The Wrong Sky
sthr-hour-6.text: When reached: add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the next reset. If the log shows "What the Almanac Hid," instead each investigator removes 1 Static token.
sthr-hour-6.back_flavor: The sky is wrong in a new way now: a starless patch the shape of an open door, fraying at its edges.
sthr-hour-6.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-7.name: Hour VII — The Guest Approaches
sthr-hour-7.text: When reached: the Appointed's Approach advances to at least Emerging (Hour VIII advances it to Arrived). If the log shows "The Appointed's Name," it arrives exhausted.
sthr-hour-7.back_flavor: Every dog in Ambergrove faces the same way. Something is coming up the hill toward the Square, politely, with all the time in the world.
sthr-hour-7.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-8.name: Hour VIII — Almost
sthr-hour-8.text: When reached: raise Dissonance by 2. The Appointed's Approach advances to Arrived. All enemies get +1 fight until the next reset.
sthr-hour-8.back_flavor: One minute to midnight. It has been one minute to midnight for a very long time. The seam in the sky pulls taut.
sthr-hour-8.back_text: The Hourglass turns. Advance to the next Hour.

sthr-hour-9.name: Hour IX — The Appointed Hour
sthr-hour-9.text: When reached: the night ends. Trigger a reset. If the log shows "The Way the Night Breaks," you may attempt the finale instead.
sthr-hour-9.back_flavor: The occultation completes, exactly as the almanac promised.
sthr-hour-9.back_text:
The night ends.
In the Prologue: (→R2).
During a loop: if "The Way the Night Breaks" is recorded, you may attempt the finale instead of resetting (see Contest the Crossing). Otherwise, (→Loop Resolution R1).
During the finale: the finale ends. Turn to the Finale Resolutions in the Campaign Guide.

sthr-losthour.name: Lost Hour
sthr-losthour.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. If the Hourglass is at Hour VI or later, advance it by 2 instead.

sthr-slippage.name: Slippage
sthr-slippage.text: Revelation — Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Surge.

sthr-waitingcongregation.name: The Waiting Congregation
sthr-waitingcongregation.text: Sleepwalking. While Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, the Waiting Congregation gains Hunter. Prey — the investigator with the most Memory.

sthr-drownedchoir.name: The Drowned Choir
sthr-drownedchoir.text: Sleepwalking. Aloof. Forced — When the Drowned Choir awakens: each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.

sthr-familiarface.name: Familiar Face
sthr-familiarface.text: Sleepwalking. Spawn — engaged with the investigator with the most Memory. Forced — When Familiar Face is defeated: that investigator places 1 Memory on their investigator card.
sthr-familiarface.flavor: You will remember this face too.

sthr-lamplighterecho.name: The Lamplighter's Echo
sthr-lamplighterecho.text: Sleepwalking. While the Ambergrove Lamp is in play, this enemy loses Sleepwalking and gains Retaliate.

sthr-wrongturn.name: Wrong Turn
sthr-wrongturn.text: Revelation — Each investigator moves to a connecting location of the lead investigator's choice. This move is not a Skip and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
sthr-wrongturn.flavor: The map is not where you left it.

sthr-rewind.name: Rewind
sthr-rewind.text: Revelation — Return the most recent clue you discovered this round to its location. If you have discovered no clues this round, instead take 2 horror.

sthr-deadair.name: Dead Air
sthr-deadair.text: Revelation — Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of your next turn. Until then, Static tokens are treated as -4 instead of -3.

sthr-loopnotices.name: The Loop Notices You
sthr-loopnotices.text: Revelation — Raise Dissonance by 1. If you have played a Recollection or triggered a foreknowledge ability this round, raise it by 2 instead.

sthr-yearinanight.name: A Year in a Night
sthr-yearinanight.text: Revelation — Test [wil] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. If you fail, increase your Years by 1 (apply any bracket change at the next interlude).

sthr-forgotten.name: What You've Forgotten
sthr-forgotten.text: Revelation — Remove 2 Memory from among your cards. For each Memory you cannot remove, take 1 horror instead.

sthr-oldbones.name: Old Bones
sthr-oldbones.text: Revelation — If you are Elder or Ancient, take 2 damage; otherwise take 1 damage. If you are Elder or Ancient and have no [com] or [agi] icons in hand to commit, take 1 additional horror.
sthr-oldbones.flavor: Your body remembers what your mind won't.

sthr-crossing.name: The Crossing
sthr-crossing.text: Revelation — Advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage (to a minimum of Sensed). Then raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-loc-square.name: The Square
sthr-loc-square.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

sthr-loc-longpier.name: The Long Pier
sthr-loc-longpier.flavor: You came to Ambergrove for your own reasons. You will not remember why, soon.

sthr-loc-almanacsteps.name: The Almanac Steps
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.text: Objective — If 5+ total clues have been gathered, an investigator here may resolve the Occultation (no test).

tokens.text: -1. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, -2 instead.
-2. If you fail, raise Dissonance by 1.
-3. If the Appointed is Sensed or later, take 1 horror.
-4. If you fail, advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.name: The Lantern Room
sthr-loc-lanternroom.text:
Objective — With 4+ clues discovered in this district, test [com] or [wil] (3) here to light the lamp. Success: record "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
When the log shows "The Lamp Was Never Lit," place this location calm side up.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.flavor: The light remembers a path the dark has forgotten.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_text:
Calm side: use it from setup once the log shows "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
[action] Light the lamp (no test). While it is lit this loop, Echoes at connected districts stay Sleepwalking one band longer, and The Dark That Waits treats investigators here as not at the Lantern Room.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_flavor: You know how to light it now. Some part of you always did.

sthr-loc-windingstair.name: The Winding Stair
sthr-loc-windingstair.text: [action] Test [agi] (2) to climb. If you fail, take 1 damage.

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.name: The Keeper's Quarters
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text: Deep objective (Act II, lamp lit) — Spend 2 clues from here to read the keeper's logbook. Record "The Keeper's Ninth Death."

sthr-darkthatwaits.name: The Dark That Waits
sthr-darkthatwaits.text: Revelation — If you are at the Lantern Room, take 2 horror; otherwise take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-nave.name: The Nave
sthr-loc-nave.flavor: The congregation is still here. They have been kneeling since the first toll.

sthr-loc-belfry.name: The Belfry
sthr-loc-belfry.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times. The thirteenth is the sound the night is stuck on.

sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.name: The Flooded Crypt
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.text: Sealed until the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll." Deep objective — Recover the drowned almanac-page (3 clues here). Record "The Hour Was Wrong."

sthr-loc-vestry.name: The Vestry
sthr-loc-vestry.text: Objective — With 6+ clues discovered in this district, read the register here. Record "The Thirteenth Toll."

sthr-thirteen.name: Thirteen
sthr-thirteen.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. If you are at a Church location, also raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-risingwater.name: Rising Water
sthr-risingwater.text: Revelation — The location you are at gets +1 shroud until the end of the round.

sthr-loc-milestones.name: The Milestones
sthr-loc-milestones.flavor: The road between the town and the shore, counted out in stones that never change.

sthr-loc-lowbridge.name: The Low Bridge
sthr-loc-lowbridge.flavor: The water never quite reaches the top. It never quite goes down.

sthr-loc-turning.name: The Turning
sthr-loc-turning.text: Objective — Move Turning → Bridge → Milestones (reverse of the Echoes), discovering 1+ clue at each. Record "The Road Remembers." Deep objective (Act II) — evade or Hold an awakened Echo here and read the face beneath the hood. Record "Who Walks Beside You."

sthr-bridgeremembers.name: The Bridge Remembers
sthr-bridgeremembers.text: Revelation — If you crossed the Low Bridge this round, Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. Otherwise, draw 1 encounter card.

sthr-loc-townhallsteps.name: The Town Hall Steps
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.text: When the log shows "The Sheriff Is Already Dead," place this location with its other side up.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.flavor: The sheriff gives the same speech to the same crowd. He has been giving it since ten o'clock.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_text:
Other side: use it from setup once the log shows "The Sheriff Is Already Dead."
Once per loop, an investigator here may look at the top card of the Occultation.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_flavor: The records let you read the night ahead.

sthr-loc-recordsoffice.name: The Records Office
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.text: Deep objective (Act II) — Find the ledger (3 clues here). Record "The Vote That Never Ends."

sthr-loc-well.name: The Well
sthr-loc-well.text: Objective — With 5+ clues discovered in this district, examine the body here. Record "The Sheriff Is Already Dead."

sthr-samespeech.name: The Same Speech
sthr-samespeech.text: Revelation — Take 1 horror, plus 1 more for every 3 completed loops (max +3).
sthr-samespeech.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.

sthr-crowdturns.name: The Crowd Turns
sthr-crowdturns.text: Revelation — Each Echo in play readies. If no Echo is in play, this gains Surge.

sthr-loc-wheel.name: The Wheel
sthr-loc-wheel.text: Objective — Test [agi] (3) here to ride the Wheel. Success: discover 2 clues from any location in this district and record "The Wheel Still Turns."

sthr-loc-ticketbooth.name: The Ticket Booth
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.text: Deep objective (Act II) — Speak with the ticket-taker. Record "The Ticket-Taker's Bargain."

sthr-wheelsturn.name: The Wheel's Turn
sthr-wheelsturn.text: Revelation — Skip: advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour. Then each investigator gains 1 resource.

sthr-reflectionlies.name: Your Reflection Lies
sthr-reflectionlies.text: Revelation — If you are at the Hall of Mirrors, take 2 horror and add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round; otherwise take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-readingroom.name: The Reading Room
sthr-loc-readingroom.flavor: Ayako has read every book in it a hundred times.

sthr-loc-press.name: The Press
sthr-loc-press.text: Objective — With 2 [perinv] or more clues discovered in this district, set the Press to reprint the true time. Record "What the Almanac Hid."

sthr-loc-sealedstudy.name: The Sealed Study
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.text: Sealed until the log shows "What the Almanac Hid" and "The Vote That Never Ends." Deep objective — Recover the name (3 clues here). Record "The Appointed's Name." The finale is declared here.

sthr-pagethatwasnt.name: The Page That Wasn't
sthr-pagethatwasnt.text: Revelation — Take 1 horror for every 6 banked Memory (round up, max 3).
sthr-pagethatwasnt.flavor: In one loop she found a page that was not there in the others.

sthr-inkrunsbackward.name: Ink Runs Backward
sthr-inkrunsbackward.text: Revelation — Cancel the next clue that would be discovered this round at your location.

sthr-studydoor.name: The Study Door
sthr-studydoor.text: Revelation — While the Sealed Study is sealed, add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Otherwise, this gains Surge.

sthr-loc-hubsquare.name: The Square
sthr-loc-hubsquare.text: Every loop begins here. Travel between districts along a connection costs 1 Hour (a Skip).
sthr-loc-hubsquare.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

sthr-act-firsthour.name: The First Hour
sthr-act-firsthour.text:
Objective – If 5 clues have been gathered in total, an investigator at the Almanac Steps may resolve the Occultation (no test). If they do, advance.
If the Hourglass reaches Hour IX first, (→R2).
sthr-act-firsthour.flavor: The almanac promised the occultation at midnight. It is eleven, and the sky is already wrong.
sthr-act-firsthour.back_flavor: You were standing on the right step at the right second. You watched the occultation complete, and you watched something reach through, and not finish reaching. When the night folds, you fold with it on purpose.

sthr-story-firstreset.name: The First Reset
sthr-story-firstreset.text:
Each investigator gains 2 banked Memory. If the objective was completed, gain 1 more banked Memory.
Record "You Are Unstuck" in the campaign log. Act I begins.
No Years are gained from the Prologue. Proceed to the first interlude, then Loop 1.
sthr-story-firstreset.flavor: The occultation completes. Something reaches through — and does not finish reaching. The night folds. You are standing in the Square again at eleven o'clock, salt on your tongue, and you are the only ones who feel the seam.

sthr-act-lamp.name: Light the Lamp
sthr-act-lamp.text: Objective – If 4 clues have been discovered in the Lighthouse district, an investigator at the Lantern Room may test [com] or [wil] (3) to light the lamp. If they succeed, advance.
sthr-act-lamp.flavor: The lamp is dark. It has never, in any loop, been lit.
sthr-act-lamp.back_flavor: The wick takes on the third try. For the first time in more nights than anyone can count, the beam swings out across the water, and down on the Sunken Road every walker stops and turns to face the light.
sthr-act-lamp.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Lamp Was Never Lit.
While the lamp is lit this loop, Echoes at connected districts stay Sleepwalking one band longer. In every later loop, place the Lantern Room calm side up.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-ninthdeath.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
Objective – With the lamp lit this loop, search the Keeper's Quarters (2 clues there) for the keeper's logbook. When you find it, advance.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.flavor: Elias kept the log for years. He does not remember writing most of it.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_flavor: Eight deaths in Elias's own careful hand, each one dated tonight. The ninth line is ruled and waiting.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Keeper's Ninth Death.
Elias's elder-sign heal also removes 1 horror.
The Lighthouse's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-whythirteen.name: Why Thirteen?
sthr-act-whythirteen.text: Objective – If 6 clues have been discovered in the Drowned Church, an investigator at the Vestry may read the register. If they do, advance.
sthr-act-whythirteen.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times at the first occultation. It should toll twelve.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_flavor: The register lists every service since the church was raised, and every entry ends at twelve. On the night of the first occultation, in a different ink, someone has added a thirteenth stroke, pressed so hard the nib tore the page.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Thirteenth Toll.
Hour III no longer adds the Church's extra Dissonance.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-hourwaswrong.name: The Hour Was Wrong
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll." The Flooded Crypt opens; the Bell-Ringer Beneath spawns there.
Objective – Recover the drowned almanac-page (3 clues in the Flooded Crypt). When you do, advance.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.flavor: Below the bell, below the water, the church keeps what it was told to keep.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_flavor: The page is soft as wet cloth, but the ink held. The same almanac, the same night, and a different hour. Someone set the occultation an hour wrong, and the town has been standing in the gap ever since.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Hour Was Wrong.
Remove Hour IV (The Road Gives Way) from the Occultation for all future loops.
The Drowned Church's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-walkbackward.name: Walk It Backward
sthr-act-walkbackward.text: Objective – Move through all three locations in reverse of the Echoes' direction (the Turning, then the Low Bridge, then the Milestones), discovering at least 1 clue at each. When you do, advance.
sthr-act-walkbackward.flavor: The same figures walk it every loop, in the same direction, never arriving.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_flavor: Walking against them, you see the road the way the walkers never do: from the shore back toward town. The milestones count down instead of up. You will not lose your way on this road again.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Road Remembers.
Once per loop, travel to or from the Lighthouse via the Sunken Road costs 0 Hours.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-walksbeside.name: Who Walks Beside You
sthr-act-walksbeside.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Road Remembers."
Objective – At the Turning, evade an awakened Echo or hold it ([action] Hold: test [wil] or [com] (X), where X is its fight; if you succeed, exhaust it — like Hold Back, this pushes it back without harming it). Then look beneath the hood, and advance.
sthr-act-walksbeside.flavor: Some of them turn to look at you now.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_flavor: The face under the hood is worn almost smooth, like a step a thousand feet have climbed. You know the coat. You know the ring on the hand that lifts to stop you. They were here before you, and they looped until there was nothing left to loop.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: Who Walks Beside You.
Echoes get −1 fight against investigators who have this fact.
The Sunken Road's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-sheriffdead.name: The Sheriff Is Already Dead
sthr-act-sheriffdead.text: Objective – If 5 clues have been discovered in the Square district, an investigator at the Well may examine the body. If they do, advance.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_flavor: He is at the bottom of the Well, and he has been there since ten o'clock. Up on the Town Hall steps, the sheriff clears his throat and begins the speech again.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Sheriff Is Already Dead.
In every later loop, place the Town Hall Steps other side up: once per loop, an investigator there may look at the top card of the Occultation.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-vote.name: The Vote That Never Ends
sthr-act-vote.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Sheriff Is Already Dead." When this objective is attempted, What Wears the Sheriff spawns at the Records Office.
Objective – Find the ledger in the Records Office (3 clues there). When you do, advance.
sthr-act-vote.flavor: The Records Office keeps every decision the town ever made. It keeps this one in a locked drawer.
sthr-act-vote.back_flavor: The minutes are dated the night of the first occultation. A motion to open the door. Every name in Ambergrove, each in its own hand. Carried, unanimous. Under the tally a clerk has written: the cost to be settled at the appointed hour.
sthr-act-vote.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Vote That Never Ends. Advance Seraphine's thread, "Who Opened the Door."
Ending the loop cleanly requires a cost the town agreed to pay.
The Square's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-wheelturns.name: The Wheel Still Turns
sthr-act-wheelturns.text: Objective – An investigator at the Wheel may test [agi] (3) to ride it. If they succeed, they discover 2 clues from a height (from any location in the Fairground), then advance.
sthr-act-wheelturns.flavor: You see the whole town at once.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_flavor: From the top of the Wheel, Ambergrove lies spread out like a map on a table: the Square, the church, the road running out to the lighthouse. Every street is full, and nobody is moving.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Wheel Still Turns.
Once per loop, from the Wheel, you may look at the top 2 encounter cards and reorder them.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-bargain.name: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain
sthr-act-bargain.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Wheel Still Turns."
Objective – An investigator at the Ticket Booth may speak with the ticket-taker. If they do, advance.
sthr-act-bargain.flavor: He smiles at you like he's been expecting you for a very long time.
sthr-act-bargain.back_flavor: He does not ask your name. He tells you there is a way out of the night, that the fare is steep, and that he has waited a very long time for someone who could afford it.
sthr-act-bargain.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain. Mark on the log that the bargain was heard.
The Fairground's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-almanachid.name: What the Almanac Hid
sthr-act-almanachid.text: Objective – If 2 [perinv] clues have been discovered in the Almanac House, an investigator at the Press may set it to reprint the true occultation time. If they do, advance.
sthr-act-almanachid.flavor: Where the wrong almanac was printed.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_flavor: The press groans and runs. The pages come out warm, and wrong in a new way: the hour printed on them is the right one. For a moment the sky over the Almanac House looks almost ordinary.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: What the Almanac Hid.
At Hour VI, investigators remove a Static token instead of adding one.
If the campaign is in Act II, advance to act 2a. Otherwise, set this act deck aside until the next loop.

sthr-act-appointedname.name: The Appointed's Name
sthr-act-appointedname.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "What the Almanac Hid" and "The Vote That Never Ends." The Sealed Study opens.
Objective – Recover the name inside the Sealed Study (3 clues there). When you do, advance.
sthr-act-appointedname.flavor: Inside is the name the town spoke to call the thing through.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_flavor: It is written once, in the middle of an otherwise blank page. You read it. You do not say it aloud. Somewhere on the hill, something pauses mid-step.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Appointed's Name. This completes "Who Opened the Door." The Appointed now arrives exhausted at Hour VII.
If you know "The Appointed's Name," "The Vote That Never Ends" and any one other deep fact, also record: The Way the Night Breaks. The finale may now be attempted.
The Almanac House's objectives are complete. Remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-lasthour.name: Contest the Crossing
sthr-act-lasthour.text:
Only once the log shows "The Way the Night Breaks": declared by an investigator at the Sealed Study, or when the Hourglass reaches Hour IX (then set it back to Hour V instead of resetting; no Hour resolves). The Appointed's Approach advances to Arrived; it manifests at the location farthest from the investigators if not already on the board. Dissonance does not reset.
Objective – Before the Hourglass reaches Hour IX, gain contest progress equal to 4 × the number of investigators (12 at three players): 1 for each Hold Back success, 1 for each deep fact spent, and 1 the first time each investigator is at the Sealed Study during the finale. When you do, advance.
If the Hourglass reaches Hour IX or every investigator is defeated first, the finale ends: turn to the Finale Resolutions in the Campaign Guide.
sthr-act-lasthour.flavor: An appointment made in ink and never kept.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_flavor: The crossing holds. For one long breath the night stops pressing, and every clock in Ambergrove agrees on the time.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_text: The contest is won. Turn to the Finale Resolutions in the Campaign Guide and read the first that qualifies (R1, R1b, then R2 to R4).

sthr-res-1.name: Take Its Place
sthr-res-1.text:
Contest reached and an Ancient investigator is present.
One Ancient becomes the night's new anchor — kept behind, decades older, so the loop ends for everyone else. Mark them kept as anchor. The town wakes for the first time in a hundred years.
If "Who Walks Beside You" is known, instead: the ones who walk the Sunken Road take the anchor's weight with you. At dawn the Ancient walks out with the others — +3 Years, but free and not kept.

sthr-res-2.name: Close the Door
sthr-res-2.text:
Contest reached and you know "The Vote That Never Ends" and "The Appointed's Name."
You pay the price the town agreed to and never paid: everyone present ages +3 Years at once, and the door closes. The cleanest true ending — bought with years.

sthr-res-3.name: Break Through
sthr-res-3.text:
Contest reached and "The Keeper's Ninth Death" is known.
You force the night open and all survivors escape — but the loop is only paused. Was it really ended?

sthr-res-4.name: Seal by Force
sthr-res-4.text:
Contest reached.
The door is sealed but not closed; one investigator (chosen) ages out doing it.

sthr-res-5.name: Next Time
sthr-res-5.text:
Contest not reached, but banked Memory is 12 or more.
The loop wins tonight — but you wake at First Dark closer than ever. Begin a new loop; the finale may be re-attempted.

sthr-res-6.name: The Loop Wins
sthr-res-6.text:
Contest not reached and banked Memory is below 12.
The night takes you. The campaign ends.
sthr-res-6.flavor: The town keeps repeating — and somewhere on the Sunken Road, walking the same direction and never arriving, there are new faces beneath the hoods.

sthr-story-actii.name: The Shape of the Hour
sthr-story-actii.text:
Read at the interlude when Act II begins (3 or more surface facts known, or after Loop 3).
The town has begun to notice that you notice. Somewhere past the edge of the Square, something that has been waiting politely decides to stop waiting.
From the next loop: deep objectives open and the Appointed's Whispers join the encounter deck.

sthr-story-beforefinale.name: The Last Hour
sthr-story-beforefinale.text: You know the shape of the night now. You know what it costs to end it. The only question left is who pays.
sthr-story-beforefinale.flavor: You have lived this night more times than you can hold.

sthr-res-bargain.name: Let It In, On Your Terms
sthr-res-bargain.text:
Contest reached, "The Ticket-Taker's Bargain" is known, and banked Memory is 12 or more. The party may decline this and read on to R2.
You take the ticket-taker's offer: the door opens on your terms, not the town's, and the night finally ends. The fare is everything you carried — banked Memory drops to 0 — and each investigator present ages +2 Years. Ambergrove wakes to a morning with one more guest in it.
sthr-res-bargain.flavor: He punches your ticket without looking. He has been expecting you for a very long time.
